label: original-phase input in {t,c,a,1,p,s,0,2,z,y} shortly after a u or 2
explanation: Conjunction of recent context and current input. Mostly fires in the original phase (81% of mass), peaking at t=2-3, when the input is one of t, c, a, 1 (strongest), then p, s, 0, 2, z, y, and a u or 2 came one or two steps earlier. The strongest activations are on t or c right after a sequence that starts u 2 (u 2 t / u 2 c reach about the max). Never fires at t=0 and almost never on the delimiter. About 19% of mass is weak firing scattered over the copy phase, which the predicate leaves out. Precision is low (~0.3) because many steps matching the context and input conditions stay below threshold, so the neuron is a graded mix of recent tokens rather than a clean detector. Dev F1 0.37, mass recall 0.61.
